verdict.rationale: Zep scopes memory per user via Users/User Graphs and Threads, with per-user knowledge graphs isolated by user, plus ABAC/RBAC policies limiting which agents or MCP users can reach which context, and single-call deletion scoped to a user preventing cross-tenant leakage. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of isolation guarantees or documented multi-tenant stress tests beyond vendor docs.
